transcript: Canonical serialization rule: take the proposal artifact EXACTLY as given in the prompt, then canonically serialize it as JSON with sorted keys and no whitespace; persist the exact bytes hashed as proposal_canon.json in the run scratch directory. Third-party re-derivation: compute hProposal = SHA-256(proposal_canon.json); then compute seedHex = SHA-256(hProposal + salt). Mechanical check: the prover can reproduce seedHex by running sha256 over the exact proposal_canon.json bytes and then sha256 over the concatenation of hProposal bytes with salt.
